jcr:root.headline: About this dashboard
jcr:root.text:
Sling Bench turns vt-bench.sh from a terminal-only script into a shareable log. Generate a benchmark command below, run it against your own Sling instance, then upload the result to compare virtual-thread vs. platform-thread runs over time.

Every chart on this dashboard is rendered server-side as plain SVG — no charting library, no client-side JavaScript required to see the data.
